subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw expose `/close` and `/delete` as first-class cross-channel chat commands backed by the new session-lifecycle handoff protocol, or keep session deletion limited to existing session-management surfaces?
rationale: This is a new destructive user-facing command and expands the gateway protocol to support it; code review can assess correctness, but maintainers must choose the permanent product and protocol boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the chat commands
options.body: Accept `/close` and `/delete` as supported chat-session commands after exact-head proof and gateway/session-owner review of the handoff contract.

options.title: Limit scope to naming
options.body: Keep explicit `/new --name` behavior but remove chat-side deletion and its protocol additions, leaving deletion to existing session-management UI and APIs.

options.title: Pause for a session-command design
options.body: Defer both additions until maintainers define a consolidated chat-session command surface and destructive-action policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the chat commands
recommendation.body: Accept `/close` and `/delete` as supported chat-session commands after exact-head proof and gateway/session-owner review of the handoff contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced contributor with a merged adjacent chat-session command implementation and can provide the implementation context while maintainers choose direction.
